# Beroun Sniper v5.0
> Ultra-low latency Rust HFT engine for Bitfinex with Sovereign AI risk management.

## Key Components
- [Core Sniper](/src/main.rs): The "Hot Path" execution engine.
- [Sovereign AI](/src/sovereign_ai.rs): Bias adjustment and position control.
- [Risk Manager](/src/ai_manager.rs): Mmap-based passive observation and dashboard.
- [Shared Types](/src/types.rs): Atomic fixed-point structures for IPC.

## Documentation
- [Architecture](/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Zero-copy IPC and cache-aligned state.
- [HFT Strategy](/docs/STRATEGY.md): OFI and Grid-based market making.
- [Development Rules](/GEMINI.md): Strict coding standards for HFT.
